facts.text: the Gusteau's kitchen crew at family meal
facts.why: No family meal scene for the Gusteau's crew turns up in the plot or trivia, and no tarragon chicken is shown. The line is not on the printed menu or the phone menu, only in the dish note data.
facts.fix: the roast chicken a Gusteau's line cook would knock up after service

vibe.verdict: A proper Gusteau's menu with the right dishes and scenes, it just misses the motto everyone knows.
missing: Anyone can cook (Gusteau's motto and book)
Remy steering Linguini by the hair under his toque (the kitchen)
Ego asking for some fresh, clear, well seasoned perspective (his order at Gusteau's)
Skinner's Chef Gusteau frozen burritos (Skinner's office)
Emile eating rubbish (the river and the bins)
Ego's tiny pen and the review (the ending)
ideas: Swap 'Cook with heart' for 'Anyone can cook'
Swap 'and a sharp pen' for 'and some fresh perspective'
Swap 'Service from seven. The kitchen welcomes anyone, of any size.' for a crossed out line: 'Chef Gusteau's frozen burritos. Not served here.'
Swap the 'Colette's bread test' photo and caption for a still of Remy steering Linguini by the hair, captioned 'Little Chef, under the toque'
